hints.title: Right-to-Left Inversion Scan
hints.text: When a digit exceeds the digit to its right, decrement the current digit and set all subsequent digits to 9 to maximize the resulting value.

hints.title: Cascade Boundary Mark
hints.text: Iterate from right to left. Whenever digits[i] > digits[i+1], decrement digits[i] and mark index i+1 as the start of trailing nines.

hints.title: Trailing Nines Replacement
hints.text: After finishing the right-to-left scan, fill all positions from the marked start index to the end of the digit array with character 9.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: integer value (at most 10 decimal digits)
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(log N) time and O(log N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing integers from n down to 1 takes exponential time and times out when n is up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scanning decimal digits once from right to left takes O(log N) time with minimal character array space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that setting all subsequent digits to 9 greedily maximizes the number.
